why_approach_change: Same failure class (continuation body cap) failed 3 times: A2b, SRV-r2, SRV-r3. Root cause (lead analysis; codex consult failed with 429 rate limit and is retried at the post-workflow gate): producers bound by COUNT while the transport binds by BYTES, and the over-budget notice carries no progressing cursor, so the model can loop on the same query forever.
lead_decisions: One byte-budget choke point: before a tool result enters the continuation, serialize it exactly the way compact_result/result_message/continuation do and fit it to the bytes left in THIS turn (cap 65,536 minus the existing margin). Lists inside the result (shots, actions, plans, timeline.clips, server_receipts, sources, scene-status scenes, estimate items, nested takes/reference_versions) are trimmed item by item until it fits; never drop silently — report total, shown, not_shown and a cursor next_query.

Progress guarantee: every next_query must strictly advance (cursor = last shown stable id, ORDER BY rowid/stable key) or strictly narrow (item-scoped query). It must never equal the query that just failed. Test this as an invariant.

A single item larger than the budget: split its nested lists with an item-scoped query (e.g. one shot's takes after=<id>); if even the item shell cannot fit, return a structured ITEM_TOO_LARGE with the item id and the narrow query, not an endless repeat.

Non-search tools (estimate_media_plan etc.) replaced by the notice get the equivalent search_project_context query (media-estimate plan=<id> after=<cursor>); if none exists, the notice text must not tell the model to pass next_query.
Old 'scene-status offset=N' and 'context-* offset=N' forms return a structured QUERY_FORMAT_CHANGED with the cursor-form restart query, never silently the plain query.

Keep SRV-r3 behavior that already passed: no outcome_unknown lock, recoverable limit_reached with zero provider writes, preference candidate cap 10, OpenAI wire transform. Also apply the same description transform to xAI strict schemas (support unverified, safer to not send the keywords).
UI and D1 minors from wave 2c are all in scope.
Defaults that remain user decisions (do not change without asking): margin 8KiB, candidate cap 10, locked_fields out of scope, stray .pyc not deleted.
